insight: Made by Felo Inc. — the team behind the Felo AI search engine — and released open-source on GitHub under the sparticleinc org.
name: Glarity
tagline: Summarize YouTube, search, and any page with ChatGPT — free and ad-free.
description: Open-source browser extension that adds AI summaries and translation across the web: YouTube videos, Google/Bing results, PDFs, emails, and arbitrary pages. Works free and ad-free out of the box, with an option to bring your own model key for heavier use.
edge: Free and ad-free by default with no sign-up — summarizes YouTube, search, and PDFs across five browsers, and is fully open-source.
cons: Summary quality depends on chosen model
Heavy use favors a BYO key
